Pinned release triage: Saeka 11.9 and Everruns contracts 0.48.0

Verified both supplied SHA-256 digests. Archives contain source and metadata,
with no symlinks or native payloads. binwalk is unavailable; source analysis,
Python AST inspection, decoded constants and Cleave facts are the applicable
inspection methods. No sample code was executed.

Saeka exposes a console entry point, not an install hook. Its four Base64
strings decode to local gate passwords, not executable code. Missing modules
are installed with pip when chk loads. Updates require interactive approval.
Its user-supplied card tuples go to a checking API; bulk live results are
written locally. Randomized Shopify merchant/product selection, generated
billing identity, proxy rotation and webdriver masking support a card-abuse
assessment. Authorized testing remains a plausible near miss, so retain the
two existing suspicious card-probing composites rather than assert theft or
hidden payload execution. Both match, with precision 6.2 and 9.1.

Everruns is a source library for agent/provider contracts and runtime wiring.
Cargo disables a build script. Credential resolution is injected by callers;
environment-backed resolution is explicit and secrets are redacted in Debug.
Provider HTTP transport is feature-gated and uses SSRF/DNS-rebinding guards.
CanaryTokens is an egress denylist entry. The off-vendor URL is a test tuple.
The tool before_exec method is an authorization hook, not CommandExt.
No hostile or suspicious traits remain in the final full Atomscan result.

Placement accounting:
- All nine vendor-routing rules move from process/create/agent to
  os/env/provider. The proxy composite loses the misleading launcher name;
  every exact YAML consumer was updated. Ancestor searches found exact
  references, not directory selectors consuming the moved population.
- Base-URL and telemetry-setting matchers no longer accept a comma as an
  assignment separator. Rust test tuples are negative controls. No ATT&CK
  or MBC proxy claims are inferred from setting text alone.
- Three browser telemetry atoms leave indicator-removal. CanaryTokens service
  reference goes to communications/url/host/oob; Microsoft telemetry references
  and their transparent two-of-three group go to os/telemetry/logging/analytics.
  The group's complete observation is notable, not component. The hostile
  phishlet consumer still requires its cookie relay and suppression operations.
- The pre-exec atom moves from daemonization to lifecycle/initialize, requires
  a parsed .pre_exec call and no longer matches declarations or text mentions.
  The setsid-before-execution composite references the new neutral atom.

Final verification uses CLEAVE_TRAITS_DIR pointing at this checkout and slow
Atomscan JSON mode. Saeka has two unique suspicious traits, zero hostile;
Everruns has zero suspicious and hostile. Container/member propagation is
counted once per unique trait. Six focused positive and near-miss checks pass.
